name: pixel-agents-bridge
description: Surfaces Claude Desktop work as characters in a small pixel office widget. Activity is auto-detected from Claude's tool-call log — no announce / progress / finish calls required. The bridge picks parallel bursts apart into named sub-agent characters and removes them automatically when Claude goes quiet.
long_description: When Claude calls office_open, the bridge boots a tiny localhost HTTP+WS server and launches the office viewer in your default browser. Agent activity is detected automatically from Claude's tool-call log — no extra MCP tool calls (and no extra tokens) are needed to spawn or update characters. The main agent reflects every tool Claude uses; bursts of 3+ tools within 3 seconds get visualised as sub-agent characters. Sub-agent characters despawn after 30 seconds of silence, main characters after 60 seconds (per BEHAVIOR_SPEC). The HUD shows the count of currently-active characters and a rolling 5-hour token-usage figure summed from ~/.claude/projects JSONL. office_status is an optional self-report helper for environments without JSONL ground truth; office_diagnose returns a one-shot snapshot of the bridge state for troubleshooting.

tools.name: office_open
tools.description: Open the office viewer in the user's default browser
